title: Initial evaluation, hip, caregiver present, sparse

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Hello, Mr. Fischer. And you are?

transcript.speaker: caregiver
transcript.text: I'm his daughter, Anika. I drive him to these.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Glad you're here. Mr. Fischer, what brings you in?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: The hip. It gets stiff in the morning.

transcript.speaker: caregiver
transcript.text: He's been using a cane since August.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: How much pain do you have today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Bad in the mornings. I don't know, maybe a lot.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: On a scale of zero to ten?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Seven, I think. It's hard to say.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: When you walk to the mailbox, what happens?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I stop halfway and rest. The cane helps.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: I measured hip flexion at 85 degrees on the left, but I didn't get to the right side.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Let's cover the rest next time. I'd like to see you for a full exam next Monday, and Anika can bring the cane and any medication list.

expectedFacts.statement: Stops halfway to the mailbox and rests

notes: Sparse encounter: the clinician ran out of time; most items are not covered.
